read_base_math.about: math reading = base + per term group × ⌈glyphs / glyphs per group⌉

glyphs_per_term_group.about: glyphs read as one term group

morph_base_share.about: share of the math base a morph needs (its changed glyphs count in full)

read_shapes_max.about: cap for shapes in one event

settle_min.about: smallest mid-beat still after a reveal

result_end_min.about: still at the end of an aha/reveal/prove/recap beat

chain_seconds.about: back-to-back reveals of one component this short count as one

ask_hold.about: still after ask (wait time of 3 s or more helps everyone)

motion_min.about: shortest text/math morph or derive step

rush_glyphs.about: more changed glyphs than this in under rush_seconds is rushed

max_new_per_beat.about: new chunks entering in one beat

max_targets_per_motion.about: independent targets in one non-transition animation

split_fraction.about: targets this far apart (fraction of the frame width) are in two places

signal_min_chunks.about: a beat bringing in this many chunks needs a signal (caption, focus, note)

max_visible_chunks.about: non-dimmed content chunks at a settle

overlap_fraction.about: text overlap, as a fraction of the smaller box

plan_min_seconds.about: films longer than this need an ask and exactly one aha beat

frame_slack_seconds.about: timing slack for frame rounding (a frame at 15 fps is 0.067 s)
